test_title: PYST 8: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The marked price of an article is ₹400. After allowing a discount of 20% on the marked price, a shopkeeper makes a profit of ₹48. His gain percentage is:
solution:
**Given:**

M.P = Rs. 400 and discount = 20%

**Concept used:**

Gain% = [(S.P. – C.P)/C.P] ×100

S.P = [(100 - D%)/M.P] × 100

Profit = S.P - C.P

Where C.P = Cost Price, S.P = Selling Price, M.P = Marked Price, D% = Discount %

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

S.P = [(100 - D%)/M.P] × 100

S.P = M.P. × 80/100

⇒ 400 × 80/100

⇒ Rs. 320

C.P. = S.P. – Profit

⇒ 320 - 48

⇒ Rs. 272

Gain percentage = (48/272) × 100 = 17(11)/(17)%

**∴ Required gain percentage is 17(11)/(17)%**
